sources.agency: MOI Department of Land Administration (distributed by NLSC via TGOS)

methods.title: District area from boundary geometry
steps: Project the full-resolution boundary to an equal-area projection.
Compute the polygon area in square kilometres and round to 2 decimals.

methods.title: District centroid from boundary geometry
steps: Compute the area-weighted centroid of the full-resolution boundary.

methods.title: Boundary simplification for display
steps: Simplify the boundary with a fixed tolerance, keeping shared edges between neighbouring districts identical.
Orient exterior rings clockwise (d3-geo convention) and round coordinates.
